variants.specifics: Brackenford: Brother Anselm's novice Pip went into the old barrow after the Urchins to prove himself; Anselm gives the key to the barrow gate.

plea.speaker: Anselm
plea.text:
Pip, my novice, went down into the old barrow after the Urchins this morning. He was so set on proving himself worthy of the Chapel! He ought to have been back long before now.

Here is the key to the barrow gate, east of the ford. Go in after him and see him safely home. Please hurry!

reminder.speaker: Anselm
reminder.text: Bring Pip back to me -- whatever it takes! Mind the dark down there. The Urchins know every hole in that barrow!

found.speaker: Pip
found.text: Your filthy chattering doesn't scare me, Urchin! Come one step nearer and I'll crack you with my staff!

following.speaker: Pip
following.text: Hail, Brother Anselm, one novice home from the barrow!

completion.speaker: Anselm
completion.text:
You found Pip! Thank goodness!

I feared the worst when he missed supper. I shall scold him later, but tonight he needs his bed. Take this robe with the Chapel's blessing.

Go safely, kind sir!

journal.text: Find Brother Anselm's novice in the old barrow.

variants.specifics: Druvak: Brakka's old father Ottar is stuck in the Old Shrine, where a Spider has riled up the bats.

plea.speaker: Brakka
plea.text:
Forgive my tears. My father Ottar is stuck down in the Old Shrine. Some great hairy Spider made its nest by the altar and riled up the bats, and now they set upon anyone who goes in.

Ottar won't budge till that Spider is dead. Could you... would you bring him home? Take this iron key. It opens the shrine gate.

reminder.speaker: Brakka
reminder.text: Don't lose that iron key, it's the only one. Once the Spider's dead, the bats should calm down. Hurry, and good luck to you.

found.speaker: Ottar
found.text: This shrine is holy ground, my son, and no beast may harm a man who kneels on it. May the spirits of the deep rock walk ever at your side.

following.speaker: Ottar
following.text: Well struck! There's no braver soul in all Druvak!

completion.speaker: Brakka
completion.text:
Wonderful! Thank you so very much. I had given up hope of him ever walking through that door again!

Now, take this ankh for your trouble.

journal.text: Slay the Spider in the Old Shrine at the foot of the east tunnels. This should calm the bats so Ottar can be led home.

variants.specifics: Okkum: Grumm shuts his boat shed until his daughter Dilla, who went after the Leeches at the Drowned Chapel, is brought home; the reward is his punt and the way on.

plea.speaker: Grumm
plea.text: Not one boat leaves my shed while my Dilla is missing! She poled out to the Drowned Chapel after the Leeches and never came back. If you want passage out of Okkum, you'll have to bring her home first. Hmmm... and don't tell Kelso she took his punt.

reminder.speaker: Grumm
reminder.text: My shed's still shut. You want a boat or not?

found.speaker: Dilla
found.text: You already know the way back out, I hope.

following.speaker: Dilla
following.text: Oh, it's you up ahead! Wait for me!

completion.speaker: Grumm
completion.text:
Dilla! Home safe! That girl will be the death of me, I swear! But she's the best hand on the water, and Okkum can't spare one of us now.

My shed is open to you now, and so is my best punt.

Here's the shed key. The punt will carry you through the Black Reeds.

journal.text: Go to the Drowned Chapel and bring back Grumm's daughter.

variants.specifics: Thrane: Maudra of the Bent Spoon begs the player to bring home her nephew Tobin, who bought a sword off Wizzle and went after the Urchins.

plea.speaker: Maudra
plea.text:
Business? Oh, business is the least of my worries this week. My nephew Tobin paid that pedlar Wizzle good money for a sword that 'never misses', and off he went to the Urchin Hollow to try it out!

I doubt the thing could cut butter, but nothing would make me happier than seeing that boy back in my kitchen.

Take this key, it opens the postern gate by the Hollow. Bring Tobin home and you'll be well rewarded.

reminder.speaker: Maudra
reminder.text: The Hollow? Through the postern gate and follow the ditch down to the left..

found.speaker: Tobin
found.text: Well... I guess you came all this way for me. Nice work, friend.

following.speaker: Tobin
following.text: For Thrane and the Bent Spoon! -- Yaaaaaarrrrggghh!! ...Um. You go first.

completion.speaker: Maudra
completion.text:
So the boy's home in one piece! Bless you! He'll not touch a sword again while I've breath in me!

Now, your reward... 75 gold, as promised! And I'll tell my brother Brusk at the north gate to let you pass whenever you please!

journal.text:
Use Maudra's key on the postern gate in order to reach Tobin.

The boy is probably lost somewhere in the Urchin Hollow.

variants.specifics: Skellow: Dorrin the boatwright's apprentice Kett is trapped in the old mill by wasps an Urchin stirred up.

plea.speaker: Dorrin
plea.text:
Rotten wasps! My apprentice Kett went to the old mill for the eel traps, but some Urchin had already gone and stirred up their nest! You're all I've got now. Get him out of there!

The mill stands at the water's edge, west of the jetty. Please, be careful.

reminder.speaker: Dorrin
reminder.text: I won't rest till Kett is back! Kill those wasps if you must! Just get him out! Hurry, before he tries something foolish!

found.speaker: Kett
found.text: Lead me home. I will keep my head down.

following.speaker: Kett
following.text: Bless you for coming. Let's go before more wasps show up.

completion.speaker: Dorrin
completion.text:
Brave Adventurer, you have my thanks! Kett owes you his life. Every ferryman in Skellow will hear of this, and they'll row you anywhere on the lake for nothing.

Take these potions for your stings. Go on, take them.

journal.text: Fight your way into the old mill and bring Kett home to Dorrin.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Master Orlo begs the player to bring his pupil Nimrel up from the Proving Vaults, where Vorlath's Shades have got in.

plea.speaker: Orlo
plea.text:
Welcome to Ostrel, kind sir! We've been hoping for a stout pair of arms for days!

My pupil Nimrel, a fine singer too, went down into the Proving Vaults for her final trial and never came up! No student has ever been kept down there this long. Vorlath's Shades must have got in.

Go down into the Vaults under the west court and bring Nimrel out. Then come and find me. I'll be in the lecture hall, as always.

reminder.speaker: Orlo
reminder.text: Those wretched Shades get bolder every week.

found.speaker: Nimrel
found.text: Keep back, or I'll burn you!

following.speaker: Nimrel
following.text: Filthy Shades! You'll never hold me down here again!

completion.speaker: Orlo
completion.text:
Nimrel! Back safe! Thank you! The whole College owes you a debt it won't forget.

Here, take this robe. Ysolde sells them for 200 gold or more, but you've earned it twice over. Archmage Dorvanis has been asking for you. Go and see him in the Chapter House straight away.

journal.text: Bring Nimrel back up from the Proving Vaults

variants.specifics: Fort Krell: Dagna the pedlar, packed to leave the fort, begs the player to bring back her boy Jeppo from the Grey Hood bandits.

plea.speaker: Dagna
plea.text:
Aaaagh! Get away! I've nothing left!

Oh. You're not a bandit?! Thank goodness. The Grey Hoods dragged my boy Jeppo off to their cave up the west slope! We were all packed to leave this fort for good.

Bring my Jeppo home and you'll have the best bargain of your life!

reminder.speaker: Dagna
reminder.text: Is Jeppo with you?! Oh.... Well, those bandits are a nasty lot. Be careful up there.

found.speaker: Jeppo
found.text: Hey! The Grey Hoods took me! Now the door's frozen shut! I'll try to squeeze through the bars. Get me home!

completion.speaker: Dagna
completion.text:
Jeppo! You brought him back! May the stars smile on you!

I've no gold left to give, so take this robe off my cart. It's the best piece I had! Now Jeppo and I are off down the mountain, and we won't be coming back. Watch yourself with those Trolls about!

journal.text: Fight through the Grey Hood cave and bring Jeppo back to his mother Dagna.

variants.specifics: Varnok: Varga the smith begs the player to bring back his apprentice Nib, who chased an Imp into the old kiln and is cut off by bats.

plea.speaker: Varga
plea.text:
While I keep the forge fires lit, I have a favor to ask of you.

My apprentice Nib chased an Imp into the old kiln north of town this morning. The little pest stirred up the bats in there, and now they go after anyone who comes near.

Hmmm. I was sure I'd barred the kiln gate. Here's my key, you'll need it.

Find Nib and get him home safe, before the bats get the best of him.

Good luck, Wanderer!

reminder.speaker: Varga
reminder.text: Into the kiln with you! Now!

found.speaker: Nib
found.text: Bat bites swell up something awful, so a Cure Poison potion would do me a world of good.

following.speaker: Nib
following.text: Watch the lava. Quickly! The bats are coming back!

completion.speaker: Varga
completion.text:
Nib! You found him! Excellent!

A few burns, but the boy will mend. There's no time to fuss over him, though. Dravic says the Ogres are on the move again.

Here, take these. You'll be needing them soon enough... trust me.

journal.text: Bring Nib home from the kiln... alive.

variants.specifics: Tarrow: Brother Fennick's novice Odo chased the Urchins into the Knobble caves and has not come home.

plea.speaker: Brother Fennick
plea.text:
Ah, you've come! Good! Our little chapel has the most devoted novices in all the valley. Sadly, young Odo went chasing the Urchins back to the Knobble caves, and he hasn't come home. I have prayed over his name all night, but something dark hides him from me.

Find the boy and bring him home, and you shall have my blessing and a gift from the altar.

Here, take this iron key. It opens the grate at the mouth of the caves.

reminder.speaker: Brother Fennick
reminder.text: No sign of him yet? Keep faith and keep looking. Those Urchins are cowards at heart.

found.speaker: Odo
found.text: Please get me back to Brother Fennick.

following.speaker: Odo
following.text: Brother Fennick will be very cross with me. You may tell him I went after the Urchins for the good of the chapel.

completion.speaker: Brother Fennick
completion.text:
Odo! Thank goodness! You've brought him back to us!

Here is the Ankh from our altar, as promised. May all that is great watch over you! Good luck!

journal.text:
Find Brother Fennick's novice in the Knobble caves and bring him home.

(Hint: The iron key opens the cave grate.)

variants.specifics: Belvik: Old Mabbet, half blind, begs the player to bring home her grandson Tibbo, who went up to the Ogre camp on Gristle Hill after her goats.

plea.speaker: Old Mabbet
plea.text:
Tibbo's a good boy. He went up to the Ogre camp on Gristle Hill after our goats and he never came back.

Nobody here will go up there. But you've got an honest sort of voice, so I'll give you every coin I've saved. Will you bring him home?

reminder.speaker: Old Mabbet
reminder.text: Those Ogres fatten up their prisoners on stolen goat, which they take from every farm in the valley.

found.speaker: Tibbo
found.text: They were saving me for the cookpot, the big black kettle in the middle of their camp!

following.speaker: Tibbo
following.text: Please, hurry and take me home to Granny!

completion.speaker: Old Mabbet
completion.text: Tibbo! I'd know that voice anywhere! Oh, you were made for this sort of work, stranger. I can't pay you what it's worth... But please, take this as a token of my appreciation!
